Definition: adverb from a derivative of G4483; out-spokenly, i.e. distinctly:--expressly.
BiblicalUsage: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that when the Spirit speaks expressly, we should listen expressly.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
